text:
Priya: Thanks everyone for joining today — quick post-huddle synthesis and explicit owners so nothing slips. I captured a tiny priorities heatmap and action map below. :sparkles:

Marco: can you confirm the Dedicated GA target quarter? I thought we said late Q3 but notes were fuzzy.

Marco: Confirmed — target is late Q3 for initial GA (EU + US regions). Still gating on two things: (1) autoscaling polish, (2) customer onboarding docs.

Sonia: Re: observability retention — leadership asked for 90 days by default for enterprise customers; we need a cost/infra plan. Owner: Sonia + EngInfra.

Priya: Action: Sonia to draft retention cost estimate and rollout plan. Owner: @Sonia due EOD Wed. Link to current retention doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/OBS-RETENTION

Ken: For autoscaling polish, I can take lead on probe stability and backfill tests. Will add a checklist in the repo. Owner: Ken, target PR by next Tue.

Taylor: I'll coordinate the onboarding docs and templates for Dedicated. Putting a skeleton in the docs repo now: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pulls — will ping when ready.

Marco: One clarification from leadership: fallback policy for model variants — we should default to cheaper-compatible variant when latency SLOs can still be met. Ops teams, make sure your routing policies support that.

Ken: Noted. Will add a routing policy test to the SRE smoke suite. Owner: Ken + Eng-SRE, target 2 weeks.

Priya: Small heatmap (verbal): High impact / high effort = Dedicated GA onboarding; High impact / low effort = better default batching suggestions in Redwood Optimize; Low impact / low effort = tweak admin UI wording. Please flag disagreements.

Sonia: Disagree slightly — batching suggestions may be medium effort if we add per-workload analytics. Let's queue a quick spike. Owner: Sonia + DevEx, 5d spike.

Priya: Good call. Added spike.

deploy-bot: [deploy] docs/site updated by Taylor — staging preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/1256

Marco: Logistics: I'll set up a shared board (Miro) for the heatmap + owners so PMs and Eng leads can track. Expect invite by EOD today.

Taylor: For follow-ups, please add open asks to the AH tracking doc so we can reconcile before next all-hands: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/ALLHANDS-TRACKER

Priya: Summary action list (please ACK in thread):
```
- Sonia: retention cost + rollout plan — due Wed EOD
- Ken: autoscale probe & routing tests + SRE smoke updates — PR/plan by Tue, smoke in 2w
- Taylor: Dedicated onboarding docs skeleton + staging preview — ping when PR ready
- Marco: Miro heatmap board + GA timeline confirmation — invite sent EOD
- Sonia+DevEx: batching suggestions spike — 5d
- All: add open asks to AH tracker
```

Ken: ACK

Sonia: ACK — will post draft Wednesday morning for comments.

Taylor: ACK — skeleton up in 10m.

Marco: ACK — will DM if timeline shifts.

Priya: Thanks — if you want to rearrange priorities on the board ping me. I'll follow-up with a one-pager summarizing decisions tomorrow. :memo:
